<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "The page clearly reads 民 at the top of column 4 (亂民), and 亂民 recurs later in 是亂民. The transcription matches the page."}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "Page form reads 義 (羊 over 我), matching the transcription"}, {"id": "c2", "confirmed": true, "severity": "material", "why": "Name in the note is 宋斑, not 珽; this changes the person's name"}, {"id": "c4", "confirmed": true, "severity": "material", "why": "Main-text name is 宋斑, not 珽; this changes the person's name"}, {"id": "c5", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "Page clearly reads 宋武德輿 (Liu Yu's courtesy name), not 帝書"}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "why": "page clearly reads 同藥通口服然; 通口 is correct"}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "why": "page reads 象 (溫涼中象政和, as in 釋名); transcription correct"}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": true, "severity": "material", "why": "The page has 皁, giving 山皁角 (soap-pod). 阜 means 'mound' and changes the common plant name."}, {"id": "c2", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "The glyph has the 艹 + 麻 structure of 蘼, so 刺蘼 is correct as transcribed. It is not 藤."}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "愛 is in the transcription, opening the line 愛故歲凶"}, {"id": "c2", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "憂 is in the transcription, opening the line 憂君非不能"}, {"id": "c3", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "page character looks like 王 with no dot; transcription matches"}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "severity": "minor", "why": "Page title clearly has the 酉 radical (酢), unlike the 魚-radical 鮓 in the body; the transcription matches the page"}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "why": "page clearly shows 嬌 (女+喬) after 男, not 婦; transcription matches"}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "why": "Glyph has 白 on the left, so it is 魄 as transcribed; the phrase 魂魄不相交接 fits"}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": true, "severity": "material", "why": "The page has 兔 (rabbit), with its dot at the lower right, matching the standard phrase 掩兔之畢. Reading it as 兕 (rhinoceros) changes the animal named."}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": false, "why": "The small note 江海處 / 下百川 is on the page after 故大得民也."}, {"id": "c2", "confirmed": true, "severity": "material", "why": "The glossed word is 遠 (from 四遠於陽), with the reading 袁願反. 遷表 names a word not in the text and gives a wrong reading."}]}
<<<END>>>

<<<BEGIN>>>
{"claims": [{"id": "c1", "confirmed": true, "severity": "minor", "why": "The right side of the character looks like 賣, so 續 'continue', not 績; 續 fits 'take another cluster and continue'. Judged at display resolution, so not certain."}, {"id": "c2", "confirmed": false, "why": "The glyph on the page looks like 令, the same as the transcription. 今 would read better, but the scribe appears to have written 令."}]}
<<<END>>>
